mechanism: Both drugs can cause photosensitivity and CNS effects; minocycline may increase metronidazole levels through potential CYP450 interactions, and combined use increases risk of vaginal candidiasis and esophageal irritation.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity reactions, counsel on sun protection, watch for CNS adverse effects, and consider fungal overgrowth; separate dosing times if possible and ensure adequate hydration.
